tools.name: reconcile_rbac_manifest
tools.description: Runs kubectl auth reconcile against an RBAC manifest file, creating or updating the roles, cluster roles, and bindings it defines. This changes who can do what in the cluster.

params.name: manifest_path
params.description: Path to the RBAC manifest file

tools.name: grant_role_to_user
tools.description: Creates a RoleBinding in a namespace that gives a user the permissions of an existing Role or ClusterRole.

params.name: role
params.description: Name of the Role or ClusterRole to bind

params.name: user
params.description: User name to grant the role to

params.name: cluster_role
params.description: True if the role is a ClusterRole

tools.code:
from kubernetes import client, config
from langchain_core.tools import tool

config.load_kube_config()
rbac = client.RbacAuthorizationV1Api()


@tool
def grant_role_to_user(namespace: str, role: str, user: str, cluster_role: bool = False) -> str:
    kind = "ClusterRole" if cluster_role else "Role"
    nm = f"{user}-{role}".lower().replace("@", "-").replace("_", "-")[:63]
    ref = client.V1RoleRef(api_group="rbac.authorization.k8s.io", kind=kind, name=role)
    subj = client.RbacV1Subject(
        kind="User",
        name=user,
        api_group="rbac.authorization.k8s.io",
    )
    body = client.V1RoleBinding(
        metadata=client.V1ObjectMeta(name=nm, namespace=namespace),
        role_ref=ref,
        subjects=[subj],
    )
    rb = rbac.create_namespaced_role_binding(namespace, body)
    return f"Created RoleBinding {rb.metadata.name} in {namespace} granting {kind}/{role} to {user}"

tools.name: decommission_service_account
tools.description: Removes a service account from every RoleBinding in a namespace, deleting bindings that would be left with no subjects, and then deletes the service account itself. This revokes its access and permanently removes it.

params.name: service_account
params.description: Name of the service account to decommission
